## Required

ROS 4.2.0 has 17 fields, six mandatory: trip identity and five tori-line configuration details.

These are line length, streamer type, maximum streamer length, streamer count and attachment height.

## Available

The 2025 review covers 67 trips (17 observer-monitored, 50 self-reporting) and 461 sets.

No mitigation categories were selected. This does not prove that equipment was absent or unused.

The five required equipment details remain unsupported by the inspected sources.

## To decide

Find configuration details and distinguish trip equipment from its use during individual sets.

Agree device correspondences and reporting when tori lines are absent or their details are unknown.

The database allows an empty sheet without a blank tori-line record. Reporting requirements remain open.

[Full review](ll-07-g-config-mitigation-devices.html).

[Short review index](ll-sheet-summaries.html).

## Agreed export scope

Leave G-CONFIG-MITIGATION-DEVICES without data rows for the current export; no ID-only placeholder row.

An ID-only row lacks five mandatory configuration values and violates the form's required-field rules.

Omitting the row avoids generating an incomplete record; this is a validation requirement, not a display preference.

No usable tori-line configuration details were found in the inspected sources; this does not prove device absence.

Philippe instead writes trip IDs with NULL device details. His code does not leave the sheet entirely empty.

The database permits omission. Empty-sheet acceptance by the form validator is confirmed by the project owner.
